News: Perodua offers aid to flood-affected customers | CarSifu
News: Perodua offers aid to flood-affected customers | CarSifu Search Perodua offers aid to flood-affected customers By CARSIFU | 19 December 2021 KUALA LUMPUR: Perodua is offering assistance, including towing service rebates, discounts on selected spare parts and free inspections to all Perodua vehicle owners who were affected by the floods. On the assistance given, Perodua customers can claim towing service up to a maximum of RM100 at the nearest Perodua service outlets subject to terms and conditions. In addition, Perodua is also offering 20% off on selected spare parts to Perodua owners whose vehicles were damaged by floods. "Our genuine spare parts come with a manufacturer's warranty and we ask our customers to not use any imitation parts as this may affect the performance of their vehicles," said Perodua president and CEO Datuk Zainal Abidin Ahmad. The parts includes all electronics items, engine overhaul gaskets, vehicle seats, door trim and carpet. "While a few of our service centres are also affected by the floods, our customers are encouraged to refer to any of our service outlets throughout Malaysia for assistance," said Zainal. Perodua customers, whose vehicles have been damaged by flood are encouraged to call Perodua's toll free customer care line at 1-800-88-5555 for towing assistance.
